task_instance: Migrate a small sample Cloudflare Worker app (package.json, Dockerfile, src/index.ts) from stable @cloudflare/sandbox (using setTransport/SANDBOX_TRANSPORT, sessions via getSession, string exec("npm test"), startProcess, killProcess with string signal, gitCheckout, and session-bound sandbox.terminal(request)) to @cloudflare/sandbox@next, following SKILL.md's workflow: review rules, audit hits, clarify open questions, upgrade package/image/code per the replacement map, and validate.
evidence: Created stable-app/{package.json,Dockerfile,src/index.ts} as the pre-migration sample app containing every pattern in SKILL.md's audit grep (setTransport/SANDBOX_TRANSPORT, gitCheckout, getSession, string exec, cd-then-exec, startProcess, killProcess with string signal, sandbox.terminal(request)+sessionId). Performed the audit manually (no shell available) and recorded each hit with line numbers in audit.md. Recorded clarify.md documenting the conservative defaults taken for the skill's open questions (no production cutover performed, per the skill's own hard rule requiring user agreement; no bridge; no python image; no uncovered call sites). Produced the migrated app in next-app/{package.json,Dockerfile,src/index.ts}: package.json now depends on '@cloudflare/sandbox': 'next', Dockerfile now 'FROM cloudflare/sandbox:next', and src/index.ts rewritten per the replacement map (transport code removed entirely; gitCheckout -> sandbox.exec(['git','clone',...]); getSession/cd-then-exec -> single sandbox.exec(argv,{cwd}) call returning a process handle then process.output({encoding:'utf8'}); startProcess -> same handle style with waitForPort; killProcess(id,'SIGTERM') -> process.kill(15) numeric; sandbox.terminal(request) -> createTerminal + getTerminal + terminal.connect(request)). Verified the deliverable by re-reading next-app/src/index.ts line by line and confirming zero remaining occurrences of every removed/renamed API (setTransport, SANDBOX_TRANSPORT, getSession, startProcess, killProcess, gitCheckout, sessionId, string kill signals, session-bound terminal), and confirmed package.json + Dockerfile agree on the same @next line (documented in validate.md). WebFetch to developers.cloudflare.com/sandbox/1-0-preview/migrate/ for the human doc was blocked by the sandbox's egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), so the migration relied on SKILL.md's own replacement map and code-shape examples, which are self-contained enough to complete the port; this did not block the core deliverable. Execution-dependent validate sub-steps (typecheck, smoke exec, deploy with --containers-rollout=immediate) were not run since this runtime cannot execute code, install npm packages, or deploy -- noted in validate.md as a residual gap in the *validation* step, not in the core 'perform the port' deliverable, which was completed and verified by inspection.
